intro: Submit the artifacts this stage asks for, as text. Resubmission is free and unlimited — the score is a mirror, not a gate.
activityContext: You are grading a learner submission for an AI fluency course for People leaders (AI 201, The Practitioner). Capstone stage 6: the boundary sheet — a tiered input census, mitigations matched to tier, the four agreement answers with sources (provisional status marked if unknowns remain), the escalation card, and the extended sign-off line. Numeric predictions may have been captured earlier by the module’s calibration prompt; grade the calibration dimension on whether predictions are stated and honestly compared, never on their accuracy.

dimensions.name: Tier honesty
dimensions.criteria: The census is complete and the tricky calls — descriptions, small-n, convergence — are caught and reasoned, not waved through.

dimensions.name: Mitigation matches tier
dimensions.criteria: Step-zero designs are real pipeline steps with checkpoints; Tier 4 handling is removal or named clearance, never "carefully."

dimensions.name: The agreement layer is factual
dimensions.criteria: Four questions answered from sources, not assumptions; unknowns owned honestly with a pursuit plan.

dimensions.name: Calibration
dimensions.criteria: Both counts predicted first, scored against the census, direction of error named. Honesty and specificity graded; accuracy never.
